cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide establishing two-shot to a closer, slightly re-angled two-shot right as the setup dialogue ('phones.') lands, tightening focus on the couple without changing the joke's content yet.
Cuts in tight on the husband's deadpan face as he starts the key line ('each'), isolating his blank expression so the delivery of the joke's setup reads clearly.
Cuts back out to the two-shot on the word 'opposite,' revealing the phone screen and both characters' texting-each-other punchline at the moment it becomes visually clear.
Cuts from the punchline reaction beat straight to the black title card, ending the sketch immediately after the joke lands rather than lingering.

reaction_shots.description: Extended close-up on the husband's deadpan, sour-faced expression as he delivers the setup line ('each... sending... opposite'), his flat affect doing the comedic work rather than any action.

pacing_notes: Shots start mid-length (3.9s, 2.2s) to establish the mundane sitting-on-the-couch scenario, then the pacing intentionally slows into one long ~5.6s held close-up on the husband's face as he delivers the deadpan setup line, letting his expression breathe before the punchline. It then snaps back to a slightly shorter two-shot (~3s) for the reveal/punchline, and closes on a brief 1.4s title card. Rather than accelerating into the punchline, this edit relies on a single extended reaction shot as the comedic anchor, with cuts placed on dialogue beats rather than rapid-fire rhythm.
